text: The couple have no complaints. With the money they build a two storey mansion, with iron bars on the windows so that angels can't get in. Pelayo gives up his job and keeps rabbits; Elisenda buys satin shoes. The child grows up and plays in the rotting coop, and he and the angel catch chicken pox together. The doctor who listens to the angel's chest finds so many noises he seems impossible alive, but the wings look so natural that the doctor wonders why other men don't have them.
